summary: Frontend-only visual/layout validation of the recharge modal on /carteira. Verified that the orange badges 'Mais popular' (pacote R$ 50,00) and 'Melhor custo' (pacote R$ 100,00) render on a SINGLE line and DO NOT overlap the package value texts, both on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844).

desktop_1920x1080.pacote-50 badge: 'Mais popular' height=18px (single line), bottom=495.5 | value top=499.5 → 4px gap, no overlap
desktop_1920x1080.pacote-100 badge: 'Melhor custo' height=18px (single line), bottom=495.5 | value top=499.5 → 4px gap, no overlap

mobile_390x844.pacote-50 badge: 'Mais popular' height=18px, bottom=344.5 | value top=348.5 → 4px gap, no overlap
mobile_390x844.pacote-100 badge: 'Melhor custo' height=18px, bottom=410.5 | value top=414.5 → 4px gap, no overlap (row wraps to 2 rows on mobile as expected via grid-cols-2, gap-y-4 provides sufficient vertical spacing)

test_credentials: Created ephemeral user via POST /api/auth/registro, elevated to enterprise+email_verificado in Mongo, then deleted after test.
seed_data_creation: Temporary test user created and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Badge layout fix in Carteira.js (whitespace-nowrap, leading-none, absolute -top-2.5, grid gap-y-4 mt-3) is confirmed working. Badges render above cards in single line without overlapping values on desktop and mobile.
rca of the issue: Previously the badge used text that could wrap into 2 lines and there was insufficient vertical spacing above cards, causing overlap onto the value text. Fix (whitespace-nowrap + leading-none on badge + grid gap-y-4 + mt-3) enforces single-line badge + guarantees vertical clearance.
